title: Tactical Scene, Lighting, Fog, Elevation & Hazard Authoring
objective: Implement tactical-map authoring for grid calibration, measurement/templates, spawn/waypoint zones, cover/elevation annotations, hazard/light inputs, wall/door occlusion geometry and fog painting/preview while keeping runtime LOS, collision, cover, movement and hazard adjudication with Scene/Combat/Visibility owners.

scope.purpose: Provide tactical-scene cartographic authoring and preview over completed MCS map foundations without becoming runtime Scene/Combat/Visibility adjudication authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative tactical documents can deterministically author and inspect grid calibration, measurements/templates, spawn/waypoint zones, cover/elevation annotations, hazard/light inputs, wall/door occlusion geometry and fog presentation while runtime LOS, collision, cover, movement and hazard adjudication remain Scene/Combat/Visibility owner authority.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree MCS-15 publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order; MCS-18 is next selected.

MCS-15 delivered deterministic square/hex/gridless calibration, measurements/templates, spawn/waypoint zones, cover/elevation annotations, hazard/light inputs, wall/door occlusion geometry and fog paint/preview projections.
A5/Scene retained canonical scene state; Combat/Exploration retained tactical adjudication; Visibility/Permissions retained visibility and permission truth.
Wall/door geometry did not infer runtime collision or occlusion, fog preview did not grant visibility, and MCS-15 performed no LOS, cover, movement, hazard, lighting or combat adjudication.
Generalized semantic binding and owner-version synchronization remained reserved to MCS-18.
MCS-18, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work were not started by this execution.
next_action: MCS-15 is closed. MCS-18 is selected_not_started; wait for a later owner Continue before granting MCS-18 implementation authority.
